PREFIX ref: <http://w3.org/ns/ren-fi#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label "Perimeter_mid_ZN_3" .
  ?point brick:hasSubEntity ?zone ; a brick:AirTemperatureSensor .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

} LIMIT 10

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.1/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3.org/ns/ren-fi#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?cls ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_mid_ZN_3" .
  ?point ?p ?o .
  FILTER(
    (a ?point ?o && strstarts(str(?o), "http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office") )
    || (?point brick:hasSubEntity ?o && strstarts(str(?o), "http://buildgraph.org"))
  )
  ?point a ?cls .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
} LIMIT 50
